goal: Audit finding tracker: findings from an audit tracked to closure with owners and evidence.
use: Audit finding tracker: findings from an audit tracked to closure with owners and evidence. Use when an audit or assessment produced findings.

steps.note: List the findings with their severity and the control they affect.
Assign each an owner and a due date.
Track the actions. Each action has a status and the evidence of completion.
Check the closure. A finding closes only when its evidence is reviewed.
Report. The open findings, the overdue ones and the evidence still needed.
